description: Nevin Vu is a Senior Solution Architect in Melbourne who designs scalable, practical systems and builds his own ideas across APIs, smartwatch apps and hardware.

headline: Designing systems.
Building ideas.
Making technology work.
hero.text: I'm Nevin, a Senior Solution Architect based in Melbourne. I turn complex technical problems into scalable, practical solutions, and bring my own ideas to life through software and hardware.

about.headline: An architect by profession. A builder by nature.
paragraphs: By day I work as a Senior Solution Architect, turning business needs into systems that are practical to build, sensible to run and secure by design. Most of that work is about decisions: what to connect, what to keep simple, and which trade-offs are worth making.

Outside of work I still write code, because I like making things. An open API for amiibo data, a live golf leaderboard for a smartwatch, a weather display on a Raspberry Pi. If an idea is interesting enough, I usually end up building it.

expertise.headline: Good architecture is a series of good decisions.
expertise.text: Technology choices matter, but the real work is understanding the problem, weighing the trade-offs and getting something dependable delivered.

items.title: Solution Architecture
items.text: Translating business requirements into a clear technical direction: a design people can understand, build and still live with years later.

items.title: System Design & Integration
items.text: Connecting systems so data flows where it should. Clean interfaces, well-defined contracts and as few moving parts as the problem allows.

items.title: Cloud & Infrastructure
items.text: Choosing where things run and how, balancing cost, operability and room to grow.

items.title: Software Engineering
items.text: Still hands-on. Writing code keeps my designs honest about what is actually easy or hard to build.

items.title: Security, Reliability & Scale
items.text: Designing for the bad day as well as the good one: secure by default, resilient to failure, ready for load.

items.title: Technical Leadership
items.text: Helping teams and stakeholders reach the same picture by explaining options plainly, making the call, and staying close enough to delivery to see it through.

projects.headline: Things I've built
projects.text: A collection of ideas, experiments and projects I've brought to life, from APIs to applications and hardware.
